title: This app really works
body:
I tried using this app a few years ago, but back then the music selection felt pretty limited and repetitive, so I stopped using it.

I gave it another shot this year and wow — what a difference. There’s a much wider variety now, and the tracks are genuinely high quality. I especially love the deep work acoustic sessions.

Great work, team.
author: Q171717

title: Great for focus! Frustrated by minor glitch
body: This app has been a game changer for helping me focus, especially for tasks that I tend to avoid. Also love the ADHD toggle. Worth the expensive subscription imo. Four stars instead of five because the track and timer sometimes restart while playing when I navigate back to the app, which is especially frustrating because I use the interval timer.
author: isabelleGT

title: Absolutely impressed by it
body: Not often that I’m happy with a purchase on App Store but this app? I’m very happy with it and use it during all my work sessions to help me focus. I really like the music. Exactly what i was looking for.
author: RedaNoueimi

title: Zulke apps nooit gratis
body: Zoals altijd is deze app 2 keer gratis te gebruiken daarna gewoon 100 euro per jaar kwijt. Belachelijk.
author: A.0702

title: Stupid paywall
body: You can’t even try it. All they want is you having another expensive subscription. Don’t even bother downloading.
author: Marianentrog

title: The Best
body:
The music is so lovely. I’m facing a massive burn out and everyday it helps me to get calm. Thank you!! 

(A little bug btw, but I think you guys will fix it as well.) ❤️
author: Hixxxxaye

title: App uses huge amount of battery
body: Since the last updates this app drains the battery of my iPhone.
author: Syrek

title: Great help to focus and relax
body:
This app increases the ability to focus on work tremendously. I use it all the time when i need to focus and i’ve been doing so for years now.

I also sometimes use the app to relax after a long day of work. I can actually feel how my body relaxes when playing the relax tracks. It really works.

I haven’t tried the sleep and meditate options yet, but even without using these options the app is worth it’s investment.
author: the*dude*

title: Amazing
body:
I have adhd and i am always looking for ways to focus better.

Brain FM helps me so much! It Instantly effects my focus. Before i wasn’t able to read more than one page of a book and now i can read a whole chapter without interruptions. Amazing 😁!
author: roozeboos

title: Good
body:
Why are all the guided meditation in male voice in the relax section deleted since the update? Those are my favourite:(. 
It is a good app and helps me relax. But I don’t like the other guided meditations with women’s voices.
author: H0AXon

title: cool and useful but not great
body: lacks basic functions like mixing audio. so it keeps pausing.
author: wannabeakungfufightaaah

title: Buggy
body: Nice idea and nice songs but unfortunately buggy.  Last update was 4 month ago so I’m not sure if it’s being maintained.
author: hgz1987

title: Flut want doet het domweg niet!!
body:
Alles uit de kast gehaald om de app de praat te krijgen. Buffert het gekozen bestand en deelt vrolijk mede dat hij nu wordt afgespeeld. Niets is echter minder waar. Wat je ook doet het gekozen bestand wordt niet afgespeeld.
Opnieuw inloggen, herinstalleren niets helpt.
Gelukkig “slechts” cadeau gekregen. Maar zelf aanschaffen: never.
Frans D.
author: LeftieGCT

title: Bad app
body:
bad app sponsored by vgz, doesn't start any track
buffering and then nothing, great gift.
author: telfort zakelijk

title: Waardeloze app!!
body: Slechte app. Werkt de helft van de tijd niet!
author: hdjdksjdj

title: Buffering forever
body: Maybe it’s due to the latest iOS but Brain.fm app has been buggy. Can’t load a theme (buffering forever), doesn’t want to play in the background, pauses when the phone screen turns off etc. I really like it on desktop, and I’d really like to use it when putting my kid to sleep, but I can’t!
author: radolaz

title: App is not workin while having a subscription
body:
When using the 5 free trial session I became very enthusiastic about brain.fm! 
So I subscribed but the app is not working properly anymore since then. All functionality is blocking and I do get the notification that I need to subscribe. When I do so (again) a pop up notification tells me that I already have one! I reported the issue twice and after first response I did not hear anything anymore! Very disappointing!
author: Gejadev

title: Crashes every night
body: Great app and love the tracks. But the sleep part crashes every single night
author: RendyHD

title: No landscape mode
body: I like brain.fm a lot, but the app is not very good as it does not work in landscape, which is very annoying on iPad.
author: niekvdpas

title: Expensive
body: Great App but super expensive!
author: Dirknan

title: Great music, app gotten worse
body: The music is great and really helps me concentrate. I was considering subscribing finally after a time not using the app and coming back to it. However, the app now randomly stops playing after 20 minutes or so and only continues when clicking the 'skip' button. Certainly not worth the subscription money now for me.
author: three_flowers_and_a_barrel

title: Great app
body: Helps me concentrating a lot, and I’ve got adhd. It’s expensive though, but still worth it.
author: VloerOma

title: Guided meditation
body:
What happened to the guided meditation? 
Other than that very satisfied with brain. fm
author: matjanese

title: Stole my money
body:
When I pay for a subscription, it deletes my account and says my password is wrong. Then when I create a new account of course it’s a non-paid “basic” account again. So now I’m out of money and I don’t have a pro account. 

Not recommended!
author: leokennis

title: To expensive
body: Such a great app but way to expensive, I would not pay more than €2 for this stuff!!!!!!!
author: Dit is een kutapp

title: Not fraudalent at all
body: I bought the full version via AppSumo and it worked perfectly fine after I installed the app. Already a big fan and still lots to discover.
author: DuMaestro

title: Amazing!
body:
Brain.fm is amazing and keeps on getting better. 

Use it mainly for a quick relax or nap session and it is always super effective.
author: Ank Verburg

title: Great app for focus & relaxation
body: I've been using brain.fm for almost a year now and use it almost daily during my morning routine and work. It's perfect for relaxation and focus!
author: NienJa

title: Fraudulent app?
body:
I have tried 2 time and paid for pro version. Every time I am told (wrongly) that my password does not fit my email address. This has happened on two occasional. Reset password does not appear to work either.

I cannot recommend this add. Certainly do not pay anything! Clearly a scam!

Very unhappy!
author: Kyller1965

title: If you're serious about focus, you need this
body: I don't usually write a review for apps but I think people need to know this. This is the only thing that gets me in focus every single time. No pomodoro or GTD technique has ever come close to what this app does for me. Plug in your headphones, fire up your laptop and do some WORK.
author: Bramm90

title: Top app voor meer focus
body: Prima app. Ik gebruik Brain.fm sinds kort om een betere focus te hebben op mijn werk. Maar ook om even lekker te relaxen op de bank of als ik niet goed in slaap kan komen. Ervaar het zelf...
author: Arco1978

title: Great app
body: Today my first experience with the app. I'm using it to focus at work and it really helps great work guys
author: Unity Eagle

title: Yesss! Finally available as an app!
body: I love brain.fm - I often use it to help me focus while I write. It also helps me relax when I go to sleep - it's so nice to hear lots of rain when you're lying all warm and safe warm in your bed- but since our wifi is not so great upstairs, I could only use brain.fm for that when I was somewhere else. Now, as an app, it finally runs without wifi. Yay! Thanks guys!
author: Kitty Kilian
